standard_prerequisites: the definition of a standard structure for the language of arithmetic
the interpretation of numerals in a structure
core_obligations: Prove that if M is standard then its domain equals the set of values of the standard numerals num(n)
proof_roadmap: Every numeral denotes an element of the domain, so the set of numeral values is contained in the domain
Standardness gives an isomorphism g from the standard model N onto M; isomorphisms preserve numerals, so g(n) equals the value of num(n) in M
g is surjective onto the domain of M, so every element of the domain is the value of some numeral
difficulty_reason: Short isomorphism argument; formally routine but requires the definition of standardness and numeral preservation under isomorphism.
